scope: CCXT public quickstart inclusive end-time Bar window calculation

assertions: 3d 1h requests cover exactly 72 bars across 3 days without an extra inclusive-end bar
1d 7m requests round up to 206 bars and cover at least one day
unbounded, excessive, and calendar-month periods remain rejected

limitations: No public exchange request was made; this verifies only deterministic request-window calculation.
A timeframe that does not divide a day rounds up to the smallest whole candle count covering the requested duration.
